# FAMILY02 B — successor-visible case facts

Blank, cell, duplicate, and custody checks pass. Turbidity is 250 NTU. Reproducible composition is 84% mineral grains and 3% organic flocs, matching the measured mineral-dominant pattern. No gravimetric reference is provided.
